messages:
anya: quick flag  noticed the /generate API sample uses an array for 'files' (e.g. [{filename:..., content:...}]) in openapi/examples. our SDKs and runtime expect an object keyed by filename. this is causing the go example in the quickstart to fail.

mike: link to the example? is it in openapi.yaml or the examples page?

anya: openapi.yaml under paths./generate.requestBody.content.application/json.example. here's the snippet currently in the repo:

anya: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "input": "please summarize",
  "files": [
    {"filename":"meeting.txt","content":"notes..."}
  ]
}
```

tau: ah yep, that shape is wrong. runtime and the clients use: "files": {"meeting.txt":"notes..."}. i can quickly update the openapi example + python snippet.

mike: will also update the Go example in the quickstart and add a note in migration.md. do we want to accept the array shape server-side for a short period? might be easier on users.

sam: we should be conservative. best to return a clear 400 with an actionable message and link to migration doc. otherwise folks will see weird decode errors. i can add a validation check that emits: "files must be an object keyed by filename; arrays are deprecated. See /docs/migration#files-shape".

anya: i've opened a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387 - updates to openapi and the examples folder. assigning @mike for SDK snippet changes.

mike: picking this up. plan: 1) update Go + Python snippets, 2) add a tiny unit test under docs/examples to assert example JSON matches client expectations, 3) add a one-paragraph migration note under "Breaking changes". ETA today.

tau: PR comment: also update the example curl and the node snippet which currently shows array form. i'll send a small commit after mike updates Go.

doc-bot: PR 4387  lint: passed. checks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387/checks :white_check_mark:

sam: i've created INF-1012 for the server-side validation message. putting it in next sprint. will include the human-friendly error string and a link to the docs PR when merged.

anya: can we also add a short note in the SDK changelogs so downstream consumers see it? some teams vendor docs.

mike: yes. i'll add changelog entries for Python and Go clients.

tau: pushed a commit updating node snippet.

doc-bot: commit 3b9e4fa pushed to PR 4387, lint re-run: passed.

mike: pushed Go + Python snippet updates, added unit test, changelog entries. PR updated.

anya: perfect. i'll merge once release notes confirm the migration blurb. can someone add to the release-notes draft?

sam: added to release-notes draft under upcoming breaking changes. linking PR. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks all! closing this thread when PR merges.
